changelog:
- Major update: Skill focus and detailed requirements for novel and story writing clarified and expanded.
- Now clearly defines triggers and when the skill should be used (写小说, 续写, 小说大纲, etc.).
- Adds step-by-step requirements: time/place/characters, descriptive and rhetorical techniques, multi-character interaction, story structure, style, and formatting.
- Specifies output format, length choices (short/medium/long), clarification questions, and handling of user requests.
- Removes previous file structure, code references, and old technical workflow; documentation now centers on creative writing guidance.
- References to style guides and sample files removed to simplify use and focus on output quality.
